roles.label: Chief Architect
roles.shortDescription: Sets architecture strategy and technology direction for the whole organization and is accountable to executive leadership for its long-term technical health.

roles.label: Staff Engineer
roles.shortDescription: Drives technical direction across multiple teams, resolves the hardest cross-cutting engineering problems, and multiplies other engineers' effectiveness.

roles.label: Principal Architect
roles.shortDescription: Owns architecture decisions for a major product area or platform, balancing technical depth with organizational influence.

roles.label: Enterprise Architect
roles.shortDescription: Aligns technology investments, systems, and standards across business units so the organization's IT landscape stays coherent and governable.

roles.label: Cloud Architect
roles.shortDescription: Designs and governs an organization's cloud landing zones, workload architecture, and cost/security posture across one or more cloud providers.

roles.label: Platform Architect
roles.shortDescription: Builds the internal platforms, golden paths, and developer tooling that let product teams ship reliably without reinventing infrastructure.

roles.label: GenAI Architect
roles.shortDescription: Designs production-grade LLM/agent systems — retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, and guardrails — bridging fast-moving AI research and real product constraints.

roles.label: MLOps Architect
roles.shortDescription: Builds the pipelines, infrastructure, and operational practices that take machine learning models from experiment to reliable, monitored production systems.
